page.notes: "Sernire" in the line for Disputatio XXVIII is uncertain; the printed letters may read Servire, which the Isaiah passage supports. The verse sign printed as a stylised V is transcribed as V. Some lines carry faint stains, but no words are lost. The reading "Dii" for the first word of Disputatio XXX is taken from the Jeremiah passage. The numerals XXXIII and LXIII are copied as printed.
